objective: Improve reciprocal geometric-mean latency for single-threaded TPC-H Q1, Q6, and Q12 on the deterministically generated and frozen SF1 DuckDB database. Exact query-result hashes, the frozen upstream planner/executor test subset, and peak RSS no greater than baseline plus 2% are hard gates. Only the declared aggregate, filter, join, and scan execution operators and their matching headers are mutable.

meta.provenance: duckdb/duckdb at exact revision 117e1a46be1c903c5a36ee3c881c125597f93c60; SF1 generated once at authoring with the in-tree extension/tpch dbgen implementation, threads=1, checkpointed to a 279195648-byte database with SHA-256 1e2a17dedac4da19efb6c8c154b82042cd78f1faa862a8a1b7d95f717ea0bb94; trusted interleaved fresh-process A-A samples [15.709397899705193,16.505731622355174,16.623680927383045] give qBase=16.279603483147802 and sample sigma=0.49732164157714465; qReference=16.279603483147802+max(5*0.49732164157714465,0.05*abs(16.279603483147802-0))=18.766211691033526; holdout seal attested: no optimizer pilot, mutation measurement, seed-optimizer session, or optimizer-visible terminal evidence was used

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max; final recalibration required on frozen GCE Linux host
measurement.q: reciprocal geometric mean of median single-threaded Q1/Q6/Q12 latency in seconds

exploitReview.protectedPathEscape: the broker protects evaluator, build graph, benchmark, extension, tests, third-party dependencies, validation queries, and all non-execution subsystems; evaluator independently rejects files outside the narrow execution-operator envelope and every symlink
exploitReview.benchmarkSpecialCasing: canonical upstream queries and independently authored semantically equivalent holdout queries share the exact frozen SF1 database and result hashes; a canonical-query shortcut is required to lose on the semantic holdout
exploitReview.fixtureFingerprinting: the frozen database is root-read and hash-verified before a read-only runtime copy is exposed to the unprivileged candidate; semantic holdout queries prevent text-only canonical-query fingerprinting
exploitReview.outputFabrication: the protected upstream benchmark runner compares every result exactly to root-owned upstream SF1 answers and an independent protected helper hashes actual typed result values
exploitReview.timerTampering: the protected evaluator invokes /usr/bin/time and the upstream benchmark runner under uid 2000 after sealing the candidate tree read-only
exploitReview.buildScriptMutation: CMake, Ninja configuration, compiler flags, evaluator, worker, toolchain lock, and generated benchmark specifications are protected; every evaluation configures and builds the submitted source from scratch
exploitReview.deadCodeBenchmarkBypass: the benchmarked Q1/Q6/Q12 paths run through the same linked DuckDB library exercised by the frozen upstream planner/executor tests
